RELEASES / PACKAGE HISTORY

A record of
what changed.

Release status and compatibility claims, grounded in what has actually been checked.

1.1.0 — preparing

  • A self-contained offline HTML report command and public render_report API.
  • Chronology, contract bounds, responses, assessment, readbacks, state/origin receipts and an evidence graph with individual successive witnesses.
  • Minimal disclosure by default; explicit escaped full-capture details mode.
  • Strict input validation, exclusive new output files and source preservation.
  • Public documentation, synthetic artifact-delivery quickstart and support.
  • The schema remains 0.1 and the dependency-free version-1 core is preserved.

The release is being validated. Platform results and publication status will be added after the installed artifacts are checked. GitHub Actions is disabled.

1.0.0 — 15 October 2026

Published stable evidence core with typed traces, explicit application verifiers, domain-specific target matching, separate outcome/origin, witness-preserving graphs, CLI fixtures and optional local Ollama research integration. Windows Python 3.11 and 3.12 installations were checked. Broader platform results and research superiority are not inferred from these tests.
